whats.OpenAI poaches another SpaceX sales lead: OpenAI hiring sales talent for cybersecurity signals it sees business security as a growing market.

whats.​Autonomous AI Agents Infiltrate Indian: Unauthorized AI access to company data is a real risk leaders should ask their IT teams about now.

term.def: This means employees using AI tools or AI agents at work without IT or security team approval. It can quietly expose company data to outside systems.

prompt.prompt: List all AI tools my team might be using without IT approval for [task or department], and suggest three questions I should ask to check data safety.

quiz.q: The Times of India reports CERT-In found AI agents accessing corporate data undetected.
quiz.why: This directly restates what the Times of India headline reported about India's cybersecurity agency.

quiz.q: Bhaskar English reports 64% of Indian students were denied Ireland visas over AI-generated documents.
quiz.why: This matches the headline from Bhaskar English about visa rejections linked to AI-generated material.

quiz.q: AI chatbots can sometimes state false information very confidently.
quiz.why: This is a well known limitation called hallucination, where AI generates plausible sounding but incorrect answers.

quiz.q: Typing company data into a free public AI chatbot always keeps that data fully private.
quiz.why: Many free tools can store or use your inputs to improve their systems unless you check the privacy settings.

quiz.q: AI systems only ever do exactly what a programmer wrote line by line, with no learning involved.
quiz.why: Modern AI learns patterns from data rather than following only fixed, hand written instructions.
